summary: Logos of Solutions BC (from 2003) and Shared Services BC, the government's shared-services organization — which carried on BC Systems' central IT role after 2003 — extracted from government documents and supplied with their sources (see package-README.md and provenance.json). The 2015 brochure's cropped vector artwork is kept as a PNG because its shading is raster (an SVG of it would embed 34 images). Specimen dates are appearances, not adoption dates; the overlap of the two names in 2006 is not a renaming date.

assets.label: Solutions BC — Figures on teal, 2003
assets.sourceLocator: Revenue Management Project procurement document, PDF page 2 (cover letter dated 27 June 2003); the same image is in the payroll procurement document of 9 October 2003
assets.dateNote: The document’s date: a dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: Four interlocking grey figures on a teal panel, over “Solutions BC / SHARED SERVICES”: the shared-services organization’s first logo.

assets.label: Solutions BC — On the BC mark, 2006 letterhead
assets.sourceLocator: A government letter (RFP SATP-191, amendment 4) dated 17 August 2006, preserved by BC Nature, PDF page 1
assets.dateNote: The document’s date: a dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The BC mark beside a divider and “SolutionsBC / Shared Services”, as on the organization’s letterhead.
assets.fidelityNote: A crop of the letter’s black-and-white scan at 216 dpi, unchanged; its texture is the scan’s.

assets.label: Shared Services BC — On the Best Place on Earth mark
assets.sourceLocator: Payroll Operations and Information Management — Alliance Management Office Report, November 2006 (posted July 2007), PDF page 1
assets.dateNote: The document’s date: a dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The BC mark with “The Best Place on Earth”, a gold divider, and “Shared ServicesBC” with “BC” in gold.
assets.fidelityNote: The report’s embedded image with its own transparency, unchanged (386 × 109).

assets.label: Shared Services BC — letterhead, 2010
assets.sourceLocator: A letter dated 9 August 2010, in Appendix C of the Vancouver Heritage Register annual update (council, 3 May 2011), PDF page 12
assets.dateNote: The document’s date: a dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The same mark in black and white.
assets.fidelityNote: A crop of the reproduced letter, unchanged.

assets.label: Shared Services BC — Reversed, without tagline, 2015
assets.sourceLocator: Real Property brochure, PDF page 16 (created 13 January 2015)
assets.dateNote: The document’s date: a dated appearance, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: The BC mark without its tagline, a gold divider and “Shared ServicesBC” in white with “BC” in gold, on dark blue.
assets.fidelityNote: A render of the brochure’s own artwork (vector paths with raster shading), unchanged in content.
